title: ChickenOnTree
description: Just a chicken on tree Fabric mod...
body:
# Chicken On Tree

`Chicken On Tree` is a Fabric mod for `Minecraft 1.21.11`.

A simple Fabric mod that adds Chicken on a Tree and music by Producer of Ohio to the game.

- How do you unlock the track?
Just kill those chickens while holding a Raw Chicken.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/5Dedo8cpMrk" title="Showcase" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
Showcase

## Features

- Ritual oak growth triggered by a buried chicken under a grass block
- Static tree chickens anchored to leaf blocks
- Custom short tree chicken sound
- Custom music disc with the track `Producer of Ohio - Chicken on Tree`

## Requirements

- Minecraft `1.21.11`
- Fabric Loader `0.18.1+`
- Fabric API `0.139.4+1.21.11`
- Java `21`

## Build

Windows:

```powershell
.\gradlew.bat build
```

The built jars are written to `build/libs/`.
